functions.purpose: Normalize process events across source-specific parsers; the rule uses CommandLine, DvcId, Dvc and TimeGenerated.
Normalize network sessions across source-specific parsers; the rule joins normalized source/destination addresses and ports with email, identity, endpoint and CommonSecurityLog data.

officialEvidence.section: Custom functions imported from Microsoft Sentinel log analytics
officialEvidence.finding: Imported Sentinel workspace functions are documented for workbooks, analytics rules and Advanced Hunting, but not Custom Detection rules.
Functions created in Advanced Hunting can be used in Custom Detections if they are not saved in a Sentinel workspace.
ASIM uses KQL unifying parsers, including built-in _Im_NetworkSession. This does not itself establish Custom Detection compatibility.

correction.reason: The referenced aliases are Sentinel built-in ASIM parsers, not necessarily user-saved functions imported into Advanced Hunting. The imported-function restriction does not independently prove rejection of both built-in aliases.
